outcome_note: Long-lived successful investment begun August 2016, substantially monetized before final exit. Do not confuse the residual's weak 2025 contribution with the lifetime result. Earlier 85% monetization at about 22% IRR and later total-life about 16% IRR are different scopes. Presentation reports gross/net 634%/429%; no independent IRR recomputation.
pack_quality_notes: 10 documents with original primary thesis, split reconciliation, three-year financial/cash tables, Q3 traffic and margin data, post-results press, two operating peers and dated portfolio context. Forward EPS/multiple, exact 52-week range and own historical multiple distribution unavailable. Exact November 12 execution and November 21 reporting dates rely on compendium/public report rather than a trade blotter. Public report's claim original purchase was 2015 is rejected; primary letter/presentation establish 2016. S3/S1 not asserted without explicit evidence for final residual.
